title: This Lizard Runs Across Water at 5 Feet per Second

scenes.text: This lizard runs across water at five feet per second.
It's the basilisk lizard, nicknamed the Jesus lizard.
It stands on its back legs and sprints across the surface.
It covers about fifteen feet before it sinks.
Each foot slaps the water, then pushes down to hold the lizard up.
Then it drops to all fours and swims. A lizard that runs on water.

description:
Basilisk lizards run on their hind legs at about 5 feet per second across water for roughly 15 feet before swimming.
Each step has a slap, a stroke, and a recovery.
Could you run on water?
thumbnail_text: THE LIZARD THAT RUNS ON WATER
